lead_raw_text:
The SrErO₃ structure crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms—Sr₂Er₂O₆—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Er centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sr centers show a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Er octahedra, and both corner- and face-sharing occur between Er octahedra and the 12-vertex Sr polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 10 sites.
